messages:
IncidentBot: Pager: High 5xx error rate detected in eu-west during regional switch at 11:12 UTC. Alert: https://alerts.redwood/INCIDENT-5792 - metric: /v1/generate 5xx rate > 10% for 3m
Alex B: i'm on call, starting triage. pulling logs from ingesters now.
DeployBot: Release v2.4.1 canary initiated for eu-west at 11:10 UTC — rollout stage: 40% traffic shift.
Priya S: i'm seeing a pattern: auth failures (403) from clients hitting green instances. stacktrace shows cookie verification error: "invalid signature".
Theo (net): DNS check: eu-west-edge-2 returning a mix of A records (old blue + new green). resolver TTL 60s but some caches holding older answer.
Marta (prod): Customer impact: certain enterprise tenants in eu-west intermittently failing requests. support volume spiking, flagged P1.
Alex B: EngOnCall stepping in. tagging SRE and runtime. assign roles: Sam take routing, Priya investigate config/secret sync, Theo handle network/DNS.
EngOnCall: Page: @sre-team @eng-runtime — incident declared. follow the rollback runbook if rollback needed.
Sam R: Running controlled rollback of traffic weights for eu-west. will flip weights back to blue.
Priya S: quick check: REDWOOD_COOKIE_KEY rotation pushed in config v2.4.1 but appears to have not propagated to a subset of green hosts (k8s rollout race). that would explain invalid signature.
Sam R: executing kill-switch for flag "eu-regional-route-v2" to stop new routing behavior.
Sam R: command run:
```
redwood-flags set eu-regional-route-v2 --env eu-west --state off --reason "emergency rollback - cookie sync failure"
```
Sam R: flag service ACKed change. propagating to edge clusters.
IncidentBot: Feature flag change propagated to 6/8 edge clusters (ack at 11:18 UTC). 2 clusters pending.
Theo (net): still seeing mixed DNS responses from edge-2; attempting cache flush and resolver restart.
Alex B: Also applying immediate routing-control rollback:
```
rcctl apply --region eu-west --weights blue=100,green=0 --change-id 2068001111-rollback
```
Marta (prod): Support message draft ready to send to affected customers. No data loss reported so far.
Priya S: after flag off + 100% blue weight, cookies validated on green->blue transition. estimate 5-8 minutes for sessions to stabilize and error rate to drop.
Sam R: monitoring: error rate dropped 12% -> 3% over the last 3 minutes. latency back to baseline for blue hosts.
EngOnCall: handoff: @Theo remains on network checks for 1hr, @Priya to own postmortem and config fix, @Sam to follow up on routing control audit.
Theo (net): found stale local DNS cache on eu-west-edge-2 box; forced restart and cache flush resolved inconsistent answers.
Alex B: next - preserve the failed green instances for forensic: don't delete k8s pods or images until postmortem. collect config snapshots and env vars.
IncidentBot: Incident status: mitigated at 11:32 UTC. Declared SEV2. Postmortem owner assigned: Priya S. Follow-up ticket: INC-5792.
Marta (prod): Customer comms: "We experienced a partial routing mismatch in eu-west during a regional rollout; mitigation applied and services restored. No data loss. We'll follow up with a postmortem in 24 hours."
Priya S: postmortem notes (initial): root cause = config/secret rollout race where cookie key not consistently present on new instances. action items: 1) add secret sync check to canary gating 2) require secret/version handshake before traffic shift 3) reduce DNS TTL/verify resolver behavior in canary zone.
Alex B: great work all. closing incident thread after artifacts uploaded to /incidents/INC-5792. thanks :heart:
